sections.description: Every template-created page starts with schema, preview and a predictable route.

items.title: Schema-first
items.description: Content shapes are validated before reaching the renderer.

items.title: Predictable routes
items.description: Locale and slug come from the entry, not from the layout.

items.title: Reusable visuals
items.description: Catalog sections keep one-off layouts from multiplying.

steps.title: Draft
steps.text: Editor opens a change set in the mini app.

steps.title: Validate
steps.text: Schema + targets ensure the diff is safe.

steps.title: Preview
steps.text: A preview branch renders the change before publish.

steps.title: Publish
steps.text: Approved change set merges into the tenant content.

items.question: Can I add a one-off section?
items.answer: Only by registering it in the catalog first — that keeps tenants compatible with the CMS.

items.question: What about hardcoded copy?
items.answer: Editorial copy lives in src/content. The renderer should not contain literals.
